title: Kidnapping
grade_or_penalty: 1st degree; 2nd degree if the victim is released unharmed in a safe place before apprehension
key_points: Unlawfully removing someone a substantial distance or confining them for a substantial period to hold for ransom or as a shield or hostage, to facilitate a crime, to inflict injury or terrorize, or to interfere with a government function.
Enhanced sentences when the victim is under 16 and certain aggravators apply.
elements: The suspect unlawfully removed the victim a substantial distance, or unlawfully confined the victim for a substantial period
Removal or confinement was by force, threat or deception (or, for a child under 14 or incompetent person, without a parent's or guardian's consent)
With purpose to: hold for ransom or as a shield or hostage; facilitate a crime or flight; inflict bodily injury or terrorize; or interfere with a government function
Note whether the victim was released unharmed in a safe place (affects grade)
